items.source: To protect sensitive information from being exposed, all property values are masked by default. To configure when property values should be shown, use management.endpoint.configprops.show-values and management.endpoint.configprops.roles in your Spring Boot application configuration.
items.translation: 为保护敏感信息不被泄露，所有属性值默认均会被隐藏。若要配置何时显示属性值，请在您的 Spring Boot 应用程序配置中使用 `management.endpoint.configprops.show-values` 和 `management.endpoint.configprops.roles`。
